Before this file, nothing in the repository connected the shipped copy to the artifact that was reviewed.

It does not close Plan 3 — it deliberately carries no `plan` key and its `review_kind` is not `plan_close`, because tests/test_gate_state.py derives plan closure from exactly that value plus a PASS verdict, and a close kind here would flip Plan 3 closed against evidence/gate_state.json. the_addendum_binds_more_than_it_amends.why_recorded_here: An earlier draft of the §12.1 pointer said the addendum 'governs this section', which overstated its reach; the correction of that overstatement then understated it in the permissive direction, stating what the addendum amends and staying silent on what it imposes. Both errors are avoided by writing the distinction down once, here, where it cannot be lost in a one-line pointer.
the_addendum_binds_more_than_it_amends.what_it_amends: One thing only: the population scope of the sentence at docs/plan3/accepted-plan.md line 492, 'Assign every non-zero-loss prediction one or more deterministic categories', which is to be read for this authorised analysis as every non-zero-loss prediction in the already-open `certification` role across zs, fs and qa. The eleven categories and their multi-label semantics are unchanged.
what_it_additionally_imposes_on_any_futu: A fail-closed role guard: the command must accept only the exact singleton `certification`, and must reject final, shift, development, empty, comma-separated and unknown values BEFORE any RAMS gold, source or input is opened — proven adversarially on the actual command path, not merely disclosed.

Per-system reporting: for each of zs, fs and qa, the emitted text-free artifact must report examined, non_zero_loss, classified and unsupported_or_unclassified counts, and any zero-capable check must report how many items it examined so a zero cannot mean both 'clean' and 'nothing was scanned'.
Pinned input identities: the execution must use the five locally verified input SHA-256 values the artifact tabulates.
Retained uncertainty: where the evidence cannot distinguish a category, the implementation must record unsupported/unclassified rather than forcing an attribution.

Seven preconditions, all of which must hold before §12.1's analysis may run at all: the addendum has independently PASSed and has then been applied; the command implementation has independently PASSed; a fresh routing verdict permits the named action; required verification is clean; the repository is clean; the final/shift guard has been adversarially proven; and the action requires no paid, network or model activity.
the_addendum_binds_more_than_it_amends.and_it_authorises_nothing: The artifact says so itself: it does not close Plan 3, start or resume Plan 4, authorise public claims, or authorise execution by itself.

reviewer_disclosures.1_i_authored_this_because_a_packet_asked: Every one of the eighteen sibling reviewer records in this repository is a first-person account by the reviewer who ruled. The 2026-07-30 reviewer is unavailable, and the alternative on the table was for the Manager — the producer, which wants a PASS — to author a record about a review it did not perform. reviewer_disclosures.2_the_incentive_this_creates_and_why_it_: This file exists only because I did not BLOCK. That couples a reviewer's verdict to the production of an artifact the packet needs, and it should be named rather than left implicit. It is bounded three ways: blocking was fully available and would simply have produced no record; every word here is mine; and nothing in this record asserts that the packet is correct — it attests only what I verified about the frozen artifact, which I would have verified identically on the way to a BLOCK.
reviewer_disclosures.3_i_did_not_narrow_or_rewrite_the_packet: Doing so would have made me its producer and forfeited the gate.
reviewer_disclosures.4_what_i_relied_on_rather_than_re_derive: Two things, both from the immediately preceding independent verdict and both unchanged by the packet: the copy-mechanics experiment showing byte identity survives commit and checkout under this repository's .gitattributes, and the re-derivation of eight of the nine ROSS_ONLY routing flags. acceptance_rule: An artifact whose authority is asserted inside itself must be locatable and checkable from inside the repository that relies on it, or the assertion is unfalsifiable. Hash equality to a named, reviewed original is the cheapest form that check can take, and it is worth the cost of an exemption in the path-hygiene gate — but only while the bytes are actually pinned. Nothing in this repository currently enforces the byte-fidelity that this file's ALLOWED exemption rests on; recording the digest here is a check a reader performs, not a check the suite runs. Pinning it beside ACCEPTED_PLAN_SHA256 would close that, and belongs in the commit that lands the file.
